data.one_liner: Detects active VPN connections on Android and iOS with real-time updates.
data.what_it_does: Provides a method to check if a VPN is active and a stream that emits status changes. The API is testable via dependency injection and works without hidden singletons.
use_when: You need to block or warn users when they are on a VPN for security or compliance reasons
You want to react in‑app to VPN status changes, e.g., adjust network behavior
You need a lightweight, platform‑specific VPN check without pulling in a full networking stack
avoid_when: Your app also targets web or desktop platforms
You require detailed network diagnostics beyond VPN detection
You prefer a pure‑Dart solution without native code
strengths: Reliable detection on both Android and iOS
Real‑time status updates via a stream
weaknesses: Requires native setup (SwiftPM for iOS, Android SDK changes)
data.setup_notes: Add vpn_detector to pubspec, run flutter pub get, ensure iOS SwiftPM integration (Swift 5, iOS 13+) and Android compileSdk 35/minSdk 21. No extra permissions required.
